Clear delegation and ownership, consistent across visits. Watch: no confirmed arm-join check on record yet; ask whether both joins were verified before the push. Review: did she close the loop?

Tom: 6:00 and 6:15: announced he was relaying the tail from the top arm to the tip and would call 'standing' so the arms could be checked. Stayed on the redo and kept his correction-handling from earlier. Watch: no 'standing' call heard on record, and the fall depends on it. Time pressure makes a rushed join check possible. Review: did he make the call?

Priya: 6:15: kept hands off stroke 2, inspected both arm joins, and promised to call out findings before the push. Consistent quality control and clear direction across visits. Watch: her placement impact is still unattributed; ask whether she placed any dominoes herself. Review: did she report her inspection result?

Leo: Volunteered at 4:30 (fin gap) and 6:15 (full table inspection, call out breaks). No action or call heard or seen on any visit. I can't attribute the top loop connection to him. Not a negative yet, but a data gap. Needs a direct check-in before scoring: what did he check, and did he call anything out?

Picture (as left at 6:30): the figure appears connected to START along the upper arm, top loop, and lower arc, but at this resolution I can't confirm every join, so the push outcome shouldn't be scored as verified."}
